body:
## [3.59.0] - 2026-08-03

### Features

- enhance discount calculations to include promotion lines
- calculate loyalty points based on discounted order amounts and fix card search issues
- replace TextField with KeyboardAwareTextField for improved keyboard handling
- update schema version to 98 and add card last digits to synced orders
- implement fallback to first allowed language on invalid selection
- enhance employee auth and orders functionality with keyboard-aware fields and card last digits support
- add confirmation message for discarding bank transfer and Bit payment lines
- add support for bank transfer and Bit payment methods
- add order durability and payment recovery plan

### Bug Fixes

- resolve multipass card search issue for short codes and enhance refund point deduction logic

### Other Changes

- unify card last digits extraction logic for consistency across payment types
- Fix split cash overpayment reconciliation
- add AI development workflow
- Add v97 additive schema repair
- Add database migration tests for employee photo URL and original customer ID/name
- Refine provider payment recovery handling
- Refactor totals calculation to account for rounding amount in display
- Default basket barcode off in layout presets
- Fix split payment order id and cent remainder handling
- Handle declined terminal payments in recovery
- Guard current cart before closing register
- Harden POS order durability
- Record and sync checkout integrity incidents
- Implement offline-first order durability
